summary: Frontend-only verification of 4 new SoD Command Center features on /app/sod (Leaderboard Nudge, Assign From Leaderboard, Board Pack Scheduling, Timeline Toast/live-refresh stability) plus a full SoD regression pass. All 7 scenarios PASSED. Login (jblan2026@gmail.com) worked, all target data-testid nodes rendered, all API round-trips returned 200 with expected toasts and UI updates.

design_issues.screen: SoD Command Center — SoD Risk Watchlist native <select data-testid='watchlist-add'>
issues: Pre-existing/known cosmetic hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in SodWatchlist.jsx (line 186). Non-blocking; called out by main agent as known. Consider rendering option children as plain string to silence React hydration warning.

critical_code_review_comments: SodOwnerLeaderboard.jsx: email validation is minimal (owner.includes('@')). Consider stricter regex to reject malformed emails before firing /remediate.
SodBoardPackCard.jsx: day input caps at max=28 in UI but backend accepts Number(cfg.day)||1 — no client-side clamp for 29-31 typed values before PUT; backend likely clamps but worth confirming.
SodWatchlist.jsx (line 186) still renders a <span> inside <option>, causing a repeated hydration warning in console. Trivial fix: render {a.area} directly.
Nudge/Send/Remediate perform real side-effects (real emails, real ticket numbers). Consider a confirm() gate on 'Nudge all owners' similar to Board Pack send-now to prevent accidental mass emails.
seed_data_creation: None. Test created ticket CHG100578 by assigning Basis / Security to ops-owner@acme.com from the leaderboard (expected side-effect). Board Pack config was updated to enabled=true, day=7, recipients=[board@acme.com, exec@acme.com] and persisted across reload.
